Bihar men PM Modi ke karyakram ke dauran Chirag Paswan ne pradhanmantri ke prati aabhar jataya. unhonne kaha ki vah PM Modi ka dhanyavad karte nahin thakenge. aakhir Chirag Paswan ne aisa kyon kaha aur iske pichhe kya vajah bataee? dekhie unka pura bayana.
